ace2-covid-drugs.title: Soluble ACE2 and angiotensin II in hypertensive COVID-19 patients treated with different antihypertensive drugs
ace2-covid-drugs.design: 200 hypertensive COVID-19 patient observational cohort; measured circulating ACE2 and ANGII via ELISA; treatment class groups; severity observational associations. Do not depict drug-caused outcomes.
methodology_constraints: Overall n=200; ACEi 57, ARB 68, BB 15, CCB 30, and 30 missing medication classifications.
Paper's severity categories overlap differently reported denominators (76 mild,76 moderate,52 severe) and cannot be silently treated as 200 unique strata without resolving original table.
Figure 1 groups circulating ACE2 and angiotensin II by disease severity; actual dot plots and 95% CI must be preserved.
Figure 2 compares ACE2 and ANGII among antihypertensive classes. Adjustment/covariates must be presented explicitly; crude association does not establish individual therapeutic advice.
Figure 3 contains treatment-by-severity results; Figure 4 compares severity distributions; use only original whole figures or well-identified crops.
Reported ARB versus ACEi and CCB versus ACEi differences do not prove that those medications cause disease severity or should be started/stopped.
Hypertensive inpatients only, 2022 COVID-19 care context. No patient-identifiable images, invented hospital footage or anecdotal case reports.
ace2-covid-drugs.assets_approved_for_retrieval: Original publisher figures or openly deposited author article with verified reuse licence, not unrelated ACE2 protein microscopy.
provisional_story: Observational question with explicit cohort denominators
Circulating ACE2 and ANGII biochemical assays, not membrane receptor expression
Confounder / indication-by-severity conceptual diagram, clearly authored
Research result with cautious clinical interpretation

ace2-forms.title: Do Changes in ACE-2 Expression Affect SARS-CoV-2 Virulence and Related Complications?
ace2-forms.rights_risk: Figures 1 and 2 are explicitly reproduced from third-party sources with permission; do not infer that the current review's CC BY licence grants independent re-use rights for those two figures.
ace2-forms.design: Show original authored ACE2 membrane/shedding concepts with citations; use the review's own original figures only after caption and rights inspection.
methodology_constraints: ACE2 is a membrane-localized receptor and an enzyme in the renin-angiotensin system; shed soluble ectodomain differs biologically.
Receptor abundance alone does not yield a clinical SARS-CoV-2 virulence or treatment conclusion.
ADAM17 and TMPRSS2 biology must be depicted conditionally, not as an exact molecular structure unless paired with a verified accession.
Figure 1 and Figure 2 of the 2021 review reproduced from other studies with permission; do not put those pixels in an unlicensed film.
Organ expression comparisons vary by mRNA, protein and cellular subtype, and must not be conflated.
original_visual_options: Custom explicit conceptual shedding animation (not an experimental observation)
Source-specific peer-reviewed ACE2 molecular structure only with PDB accession and permissions
Review's original RAAS mechanism diagram after rights and figure ancestry verification
